admission.justification: The service build/Update, serving comparison-owner composition and supplemental receipt producer form one evidence path; real-composition tests check exact bound sides and named failures so a page cannot explain fabricated or stale operands.

applicability: The explainer’s first environment build and every explicit Update for one leaf, including a planned comparison before the leaf starts.
conditions: Preparation consumes the existing comparison owner’s opened operands and measured states.
A missing supplemental packet/reference is represented by its unavailable receipt and limitation, not a missing required comparison input.
An agreed revision is resolved and its manifest digest is verified before its receipt claims present bytes.
exclusions: A read of the review page starts no build or model turn.
Regenerating a retained page does not itself rebind the environment or prepare a replacement packet.
statement: The build and every Update prepare the packet for exactly the bound comparison, recorded or planned, through the comparison owner. A measured loss is carried. An absent input is a named refusal. A planned comparison’s packets are supplemental receipts, and its owner and reference are its own. A leaf with an agreed revision carries that revision’s manifest and its reference folder as receipts in every packet.
